why_selected: Fits the reader article and has the clearest public proof route
target_question: Who pays for power/grid expansion, and does demand become billed and recovered cash?
required_documents: ESA/PPA/tariff/rider filings; billing determinants; cost recovery schedules; collected revenue; in-service project evidence; contractor backlog and collection evidence
pass_test: A named load or recovery category ties to approved cost, billing determinant, billed or collected revenue, and recoverable return
hold_test: Evidence stops at load forecast, management commentary, capex plan, or aggregate revenue without category/customer linkage
writing_use: Lead article upgrade and strongest public proof box

why_selected: Best route back to big-money platforms and legal-entity proof
first_case: Apollo/Athene AP Aristotle or KKR/Global Atlantic Accordia
target_question: Which legal entity owns which named asset, what cash or income came back, and did spread survive liability cost?
required_documents: Statutory Schedule D/BA; investment income schedules; proceeds/disposals; liability-cost notes; legal-entity cash-flow schedules; issuer or trustee support
pass_test: A named CUSIP or issuer row ties to legal-entity holding, income, proceeds or disposal, liability-cost context, and bounded return/spread math
hold_test: Evidence stops at AUM, fair value, income without cash route, or proceeds without lot/legal-entity allocation
writing_use: Capital-platform proof anchor and big-money-player answer

why_selected: Turns liquidity claims into collateral and cash-conversion tests
first_case: United Rentals plus Target/Zebra/Pool distributor comparison
target_question: Is borrowing capacity backed by eligible assets that collect or turn into cash?
required_documents: Borrowing-base certificates; receivable aging; inventory eligibility; advance rates; collateral reports; trustee/remittance reports; OCF and working-capital bridge
pass_test: Eligible collateral reconciles to borrowing capacity, collection/remittance evidence, and debt-service support
hold_test: Evidence stops at balance-sheet receivables, inventory, fleet value, or liquidity commentary without eligibility and collection proof
writing_use: Working-capital and asset-backed proof box upgrade

target_question: Who lent to a named borrower, through what facility, for what use, and how is it repaid?
required_documents: Credit agreement; rating report; lender allocation; funds-flow; use-of-proceeds note; borrower financials; collateral; debt-service schedule
pass_test: Facility size, lender role, use of proceeds, borrower cash source, and repayment or debt-service path are visible
hold_test: Evidence stops at holder fair value, borrower name, arranger role, or generic growth language
writing_use: Private-credit proof box and platform-destination answer

why_selected: Best physical asset and output bridge
first_case: Cheniere plus Energy Transfer or ONEOK/Targa
target_question: Does capital spending become named physical output and attributable cash?
required_documents: Project cost schedule; entity debt; project contracts; tariff or volume records; output records; segment/project EBITDA or DCF bridge; debt-service waterfall
pass_test: A named project ties from funding to in-service/output evidence to cash contribution or contracted/tariff recovery
hold_test: Evidence stops at company capex, adjusted EBITDA, throughput, or project announcement

why_selected: Best human-centered theme but needs proof discipline
target_question: Does organized access become reimbursed, collected, cash-generating care without overstating quality?
required_documents: Premium receivables; medical claims payable; reimbursement schedules; service-line revenue; denial/collection evidence; labor productivity; OCF; quality/trust indicators
pass_test: Service activity ties to reimbursement route, receivable collection, labor cost, and cash contribution with quality boundary
hold_test: Evidence stops at revenue, lives served, patients, admissions, or census without reimbursement/cash detail

target_question: Do equipment, parts, service density, and backlog create uptime that converts to cash?
required_documents: Fleet utilization; OEC; rental revenue; branch/vending/onsite data; backlog aging; retainage; project margin; OCF; working-capital bridge
pass_test: Operating access metric ties to revenue quality, margin, cash conversion, and durability indicator
hold_test: Evidence stops at sales, locations, backlog, or fleet value without cash or margin conversion

why_selected: Best if the user wants to start writing now
target_question: Can we write a detailed no-background-required article now while keeping proof boundaries clear?
required_documents: Final publication draft; exhibit package; paragraph overclaim review; public citation source lists; source-note package
pass_test: All company-specific claims have citations or are softened, and every proof boundary remains visible
hold_test: Unsupported company-specific claims remain in external-facing prose
writing_use: Immediate article drafting and theme/subtheme writing
